expected_structural_delta: Two predicates in one existing production module; zero new owners, representations, parsers, protocols, dependencies, lifecycle actions or policy fields. One existing shell regression extended.
minimum_design: Extend the two existing routing-label predicates to select the native demand path for every native-owned build profile; reuse existing PHP/native pool parsers, warm targets, queue validation, admission and start plan.
outcome: Native-owned OS build profiles restore configured warm capacity and size queued demand through the existing fenced native protocol, preserving legacy provider behavior.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing native demand/warm path
reuse_decisions.rationale: Already accepts OS pool labels and protected costs; legacy scale action is absent from native CLI.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing queued-pools regression
reuse_decisions.rationale: Exercise OS native routing and queue-failure warm recovery alongside retained general and legacy cases.
